text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean absolute error of the median forecast as a percentage of capacity; smaller is better. 2 bulk supply points (BSP) and 2 grid supply points (GSP). 292 daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each forecasting up to 14 days ahead. Dot or line: estimate. Vertical line or band: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Sunny and cloudy days are the top and bottom thirds of each month's daily clear-sky index.'
text.tspan: Mean absolute error of the median forecast as a percentage of capacity; smaller is better. 2 bulk supply
points (BSP) and 2 grid supply points (GSP). 292 daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each
forecasting up to 14 days ahead. Dot or line: estimate. Vertical line or band: 95% interval from resampling
whole months. Sunny and cloudy days are the top and bottom thirds of each month's daily clear-sky index.
